beats.en: Nita and Radha are getting ready to go to the mela, and the whole house is excited. The mela is a little far from home, so they will go by bus. Dadiji has a bad leg, so at first she says she cannot come.
beats.speakEn: Nita and Radha are getting ready to go to the mela, and the whole house is excited. The mela is a little far from home, so they will go by bus. Dadiji has a bad leg, so at first she says she cannot come.

beats.en: The families go to the bus stop and Nita's father helps Dadiji walk slowly, holding her hand, to the stop. We should always help elders who find it hard to walk.

textbookBox.concept: At the entrance of the mela there is a map of the ground showing the stalls and where they are. A map helps us find our way.

beats.en: At the entrance of the mela there is a map of the ground showing the stalls and where they are. A map helps us find our way.
beats.speakEn: At the entrance of the mela there is a map of the ground showing the stalls and where they are. A map helps us find our way.

beats.en: Inside, the children see stalls with games, toys, sweets and many interesting things. They go to the toy stall and buy spinning tops, puppets, phirkis and dolls. They ride on the merry-go-round and the giant wheel.
